title: Positive sectional curvature on a family of exotic fifteen-sphere
summary: We construct Riemannian metrics of strictly positive sectional curvature on at least 508 pairwise nondiffeomorphic exotic fifteen-spheres, without distinguishing orientations. The construction starts with quaternionic line bundles over the product of the quaternionic projective plane and the four-sphere. Surgery on an eleven-sphere fiber produces homotopy fifteen-spheres with conjugation-equivariant attaching maps.
